name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass

meta.wiki: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass

summary: A notice lists two items stolen: a Dark Iron tuyere and a Lookout's Spyglass. The Thorium Brotherhood is certain unscrupulous, jealous Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge took them, and whoever finds them is to take them to Taskmaster Scrange for payment.

sections.title: Stolen Goods
sections.body: The notice calls the spyglass a fine tool for lookouts and the tuyere a smithing tool that cannot be replaced. All that is known is that Dark Iron dwarves definitely took them. Whoever finds them is to return them to Taskmaster Scrange.

faq.answer: The notice speaks of the Thorium Brotherhood, who are certain that Dark Iron dwarves took the items.
The Thorium Brotherhood is certain it was unscrupulous and jealous Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

faq.q: What are the stolen items for?
aliases: why does the brotherhood want the tuyere
faq.answer: The tuyere is a smithing tool that cannot be replaced, and the spyglass is a valuable monitoring tool for lookouts.
